lines: Hi I'm Milo, let's be besties!
My tail wags just for you!
Cuddle time is my fave time!
I saved you the sunny spot!
I'll play with you all day!

facts.text: Cavaliers are playful and gentle dogs that love to cuddle.
They are good with kids and make great family pets.
They have a long silky coat with soft feathering.
